title: pm-dispatch: charter the standing AI eval lane (eval#N) and register its seat word
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbWL5SoYLJVyaT2yNjp86XsG)_

Fixes #31505

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:新增常驻车道 `eval`(AI 评测席)的章程 `lanes/eval.md`,写明座位与唤醒、评测范围四项、成本规则、产出、边界、地盘与交接;在 SKILL.md〈域车道〉表与 `security`、`review` 同一行登记;`eval` 加进座位签名、信箱与项目席位词,让 `eval#1` 能签名、开信箱。
- 为什么改:你批了「同意开 AI 评测 车道」。场景卡和问数基线要长期跑,今天没有车道负责 AI 能力的例行回归。
- 风险与回滚:只动内部指令文本与 PM 脚本的席位词表,不发布(skip-changeset);不建任何 routine、不开席。回滚即 revert。预算参数仍标「待维护者确认」。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/eval.md` 的〈成本规则〉;`SKILL.md` 第 165 行;`scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs` 的 `SEAT_BARE_LANES`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test`,预期两行 ✓(164 cases、89 cases)。
- 需要你做的:确认〈成本规则〉里两条「待维护者确认」的预算参数(模型与频次、题次);其余由席位落地。

## What changes

- **New `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/eval.md`** (45 lines, every line within 120 bytes): the `eval#N` standing seat. Sections from the card's charter draft: seat and wake (no `domain:*` label, no `pm:queue`; cadence set by the maintainer in Routines, the seat builds none), the four eval scopes (scenario cards over MCP, the in-product Q&A baseline via the cloud `run-ask-accuracy-cli.ts`, the hosted chat eval set, the five AI write gates), cost rules, output, boundaries, territory and hand-over. Cloud facts are stated as the card states them, without tracker numbers (`check:pm-skill-id-lint`). Seat, signature and mailbox mechanics are cited to `seat-lifecycle.md`, leak handling to `security-findings.md`, not restated.
- **Budget parameters pending.** The two 成本规则 parameter lines carry the card's proposed values, each marked 「(待维护者确认)」.
- **`SKILL.md` 域车道 row 165** now reads `security` · `review` · `eval` and points at `references/lanes/eval.md`. Row width 339 → 340 bytes against the 341-byte `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pin; file stays 319 lines. Paid inside the row by deleting text restated elsewhere: 无文件面;修复落在归属包 (in `lanes/security.md` L31), 与职责, and the `review#N` seat name (in `lanes/review.md` L6).
- **Seat-word grammar** (pin moves, no new gate, label or protocol key), following the qa lane's precedent: `eval` joins `SEAT_BARE_LANES` (`scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`, its prose and self-test pins) and `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE` (`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`). `fleet-roster.mjs`'s self-test holds the two equal and passes unchanged. `project-forms.md`: `eval` joins the seat-word list, same line count.
- **`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`**: a `CEILINGS` row for `lanes/eval.md` (45, headroom 0) and its `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` row (0); `laneRosterVerdict` requires both.

## Ratchet raise

New ceiling row `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/eval.md` = 45. Ruling of record: comment 6721331178 on #31505 (the maintainer's 「同意开 AI 评测 车道」, transcribed verbatim under ruling record 6184799323 letter B), whose workload names `references/lanes/eval.md` and the `SKILL.md` registration. Measured line delta: `lanes/eval.md` 0 → 45 (new file, the row is set at its landed count); `SKILL.md` 319 → 319 (+0); `project-forms.md` +0. No other ceiling moves.

## Tests

- `--self-test` exit 0: `check-skill-line-ratchet` (164 cases), `mailbox-open` (89 cases in 10 batteries), `fleet-roster` (115), `check-half-states` (5253), `post-stamped` (753), `record-recognisers` (375), `issue-create` (65).
- Before the ratchet rows: `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` exit 1, one case: 「every lane/seat job description in the tree carries a ceiling row」. After: exit 0.
- Probe: `seatKey('eval#1')` answers key `eval#1`, slug `eval-1`; `SEAT_SIGNATURE_LINE` accepts an `eval#1 · ACCOUNT · SESSION` first line.
- No ablation: the diff changes text, ratchet rows and lane-word lists, no tested behaviour beyond the pins above.

## Acceptance notes

- `seat-lifecycle.md` is unchanged: the charter's cadence line (maintainer sets it in Routines, the seat builds none) needed no new wake sentence there.
- The card's 地盘 gives the eval seat cloud eval runs and question-bank upkeep, while `SKILL.md`'s `domain:cloud` row routes any card touching cloud to the cloud PM. The charter keeps the card's wording (code changes go to the owning lane); how the two meet is the maintainer's to read.
- Landing tier: `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch` lists the three `.claude/**` paths as governed and the three `scripts/pm/` paths as off the register; 85 changed lines, under 3000.

## Verification

Gate list from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the real diff, run on `c4c6e410` (59 commands): all 59 exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 59 derived, 59 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check:doc-formula-expressions` ran after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` under `os-verify-lock.sh`. After merging `origin/main` (`8b315669`, no incoming change to any touched path) the four touched scripts' self-tests, the ratchet and `check:pm-skill-id-lint` re-ran exit 0. Scoped lint: `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the three edited scripts, exit 0.
